decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the list to identify actual Bluetooth speakers, excluding accessories like cases, power cords, and shelves. My consideration set includes a mix of premium (Bose), high-performance mid-range (DOSS, BOGASING), and budget/aesthetic options (INSMY). I ultimately selected the DOSS SoundBox Pro+ (prod_bluetooth_speakers_008) because it offers a significant jump in power (24W) and audio quality for its $89.99 price point, supported by a large number of positive reviews that specifically praise its bass and clarity compared to cheaper models, while remaining more affordable than the Bose SoundLink.
